title: Open restriction of ring sheafification on abelian stalks
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to Y$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and $P$ a presheaf of commutative rings on the Zariski opens of $Y$. Let $P^\#$ be its ring sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] and $\theta:P\to P^\#$ its unit. For $x\in X$, the map on underlying abelian stalks induced by restriction of $\theta$ along the image functor of $f$ is bijective. No quasi-coherence is assumed.

proof.text: Forgetting rings to abelian groups preserves sheafification. The forgotten unit factors as the abelian sheafification unit followed by the canonical sheafification-compose isomorphism. Applying the ambient stalk functor gives an isomorphism.

For an open embedding f, image on neighbourhoods of x is left adjoint to inverse image on neighbourhoods of f(x). Its opposite is final, so the colimit.pre maps from restricted stalks to ambient stalks are isomorphisms. On each germ, colimit.ι_pre and ι_colimMap identify the restricted stalk map followed by this iso with the ambient stalk map after the source iso. Cancel the target iso to get an isomorphism; its underlying map is bijective.

theorem ringSheafification_restricted_stalk_bijective {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (P : Y.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (x : X) :

          (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat.{u}))))
